theater: 幽州砂城（今北京大興區西北）

battle.name: 砂城之戰
battle.theater: 幽州砂城（今北京大興區西北）
battle.brief: 開皇三年（583）六月十四日，突厥沙缽略可汗因西方受阿波、達頭兩面進逼，率部東進犯隋幽州。幽州總管李崇率步騎三千出戰，十餘日轉戰傷亡眾多，退保荒廢砂城。缺糧，李崇每夜出掠突厥六畜充食，拒降殺將，終中亂箭戰死，全軍覆沒。卡面科林斯青銅盔屬希臘青銅時代工藝，並不在此役現場。

kit.name: 科林斯青銅盔
kit.history: 全正面開眼的青銅盔。看得見的代價是：戴它的人只能靠隊形活。

countries: 這場戰爭是開皇三年（583）隋朝與突厥汗國在幽州邊境的一場遭遇，屬於隋軍全面反擊沙缽略可汗的同一輪戰事。突厥一方，進攻者是可汗沙缽略本人所率的本部騎隊：沙缽略出身突厥汗族，與兄長阿波可汗、達頭可汗（阿波之子）同族，開皇初年正因汗位與牧地之爭與達頭一方交兵，兵馬分散、畜產不足。隋朝一方，守方是幽州總管李崇率領的邊軍，步騎並出，兵源為幽州等邊州郡的宿衛與府兵屯田軍戶，糧秣由幽州城倉廩供應，命令系統上受隋文帝與行軍總監軍節度。必須說明的是，隋朝並未在此挑起戰端：開皇三年春，隋廷以衛王楊廣為行軍元帥，與幽州總管韋孝寬、上柱國趙煥等分道出擊，於白道一役重創沙缽略主力；沙缽略在西方遭達頭一方牽制、在南方又受挫，遂轉向東方的幽州，想以人畜與糧秣補血。因此此役的地理框架十分清楚：幽州是隋朝北方防線的東端重鎮，治所在蓟縣；砂城是幽州西北方向一座早已荒廢的舊邊塞城，離幽州城約十餘里，一旦淪陷，突厥騎兵便可直抵幽州城下的射程之內。西線與東線在同一年裡首尾相銜，構成了砂城之戰真正的背景。
countriesEn: This engagement was a clash between the Sui dynasty and the Turkic Khaganate on the Yuzhou frontier in the third year of Kaihuang (583), and it belonged to the same round of campaigns in which the Sui court launched a general counter-offensive against Qaghan Shabilie. On the Turkic side the attacker was the mounted host personally led by Shabilie himself: Shabilie came from the ruling clan of the Khaganate and was a kinsman of Apo Qaghan and of Datou Qaghan, the son of Apo, and in the early Kaihuang years he was locked in a struggle over the khanship and the pastures with Datou's faction, which drained away his soldiers and his herds. On the Sui side the defenders were the frontier troops of Youzhou governor Li Chong, infantry and cavalry combined, drawn from the garrisons and the tuntian households of the northern commanderies such as Youzhou and Yanzhou, supplied with grain from the granaries of Youzhou city, the chain of command running up to Emperor Wen of Sui and the officials appointed to supervise the campaign. It must be said that the Sui did not pick this fight: in the spring of 583 the court put Wei prince Yang Guang in command of a great counter-offensive, with Youzhou governor Wei Xiaokuan, pillar of state Zhao Huan and others operating along separate lines, and badly mauled Shabilie's main body at the battle of Baidao. Pressed in the west by Datou's faction and checked in the south by Sui arms, Shabilie turned eastward toward Youzhou to seize men, animals and provisions. The geographical frame of the battle is therefore clear: Youzhou was the eastern anchor of the Sui's northern defence, administered from Ji County, while Sand Castle was a long-abandoned frontier fort lying to the north-west of Youzhou, a little more than ten li from the city; once it fell, Turkic riders could ride straight up to the walls of Youzhou. The western and the eastern fronts were joined in the same year, and that connection is the real background of the battle of Sand Castle.
people: 核心人物分屬三方。隋方主將李崇是幽州總管，開皇三年鎮守幽州，他未待大軍集結便以步騎三千出城迎戰，兵敗退保砂城後仍堅持夜戰，最終挺刃而出、殺死突厥兵二人，被亂箭射死，所部全軍覆沒，他自己也血戰到最後一人。隋文帝楊堅是決策者，同年下令以衛王楊廣為行軍元帥組織大規模反擊，砂城之敗後朝廷被迫在北方加派兵將、補給與屯田，並在外交上利用達頭可汗牽制沙缽略。衛王楊廣是此輪反擊的統帥，與幽州總管韋孝寬、上柱國趙煥等分道出擊，於白道等役重創沙缽略主力，正因如此，突厥才把報復的矛頭轉向幽州方向的砂城。突厥方面，沙缽略可汗是全場的決策者：他在腹背受敵、畜產被掠的情況下仍傾國東進，既求糧秣，也想牽制隋軍北上的兵力；被派來勸降的特勤是他的特使，許以高官厚爵，企圖在李崇全軍飢疲時不戰而屈其兵。西方則是阿波可汗與達頭可汗一系的牽制力量：達頭是阿波之子，與沙缽略爭位，隋朝在其背後支持，兩面夾擊使沙缽略無法集中全部兵力，才被迫在六月十四日揮師東向。
peopleEn: Three sets of actors matter here. On the Sui side the commander was Li Chong, governor of Youzhou, who held that frontier in 583. Rather than wait for the main army to assemble, he marched out with three thousand foot and horse to meet the enemy; beaten back into Sand Castle he still fought by night, and finally went out with his sword, killing two Turkic soldiers before being shot down by a shower of arrows. His whole command was wiped out, and he was the last of it to fall. Emperor Wen of Sui was the decision maker: in the same year he ordered the great counter-offensive under Wei prince Yang Guang, and after the defeat at Sand Castle the court was forced to send more troops, supplies and tuntian colonies northward, and to use the diplomacy of backing Datou Qaghan in order to pin Shabilie down. Wei prince Yang Guang was the overall commander of that counter-offensive, operating with Wei Xiaokuan and the pillar of state Zhao Huan along separate lines; the mauling of Shabilie's main host at Baidao was exactly what drove the Turks to turn their revenge towards Sand Castle in the north-west of Youzhou. On the Turkic side Shabilie Qaghan was the man making the decisions: hemmed in on two sides and short of animals and provisions, he still brought the bulk of his host east, seeking grain and beasts, and hoping to pin down the Sui armies operating to the north. The special emissary who came to offer him surrender was his own appointed herald, sent with promises of high office in the hope of taking Li Chong's starving command without a fight. In the west stood the restraining force of Apo and Datou: Datou, the son of Apo, was contesting the khanship with Shabilie, enjoyed Sui support behind him, and by squeezing Shabilie from the west kept him from concentrating his whole force, which is why he had to strike eastward on the fourteenth of June.
kits: 卡面兵器是科林斯青銅盔：全正面開眼的青銅頭盔，約公元前650年的希臘工藝，屬青銅時代的裝備，與開皇三年相隔逾一千二百年，並沒有出現在砂城；它的作用是標示一種「戴盔者只能靠隊形活」的防護哲學，恰好與本役隋軍孤軍遠出、離開城垣而靠陣形與輪換撐住的處境形成對照。真正上陣的是開皇年間的兩套軍備。隋軍步卒以大盾與勁弩壓制前列，槊與弓箭配置於其後，騎兵用長槊與環首刀作近身兵器，鎧甲以金屬札甲為主，配兜鍪、護膊與護膝，馬上已見馬鐙，後勤靠糧車與屯田供給，離城遠戰時隨軍口糧極易中斷。突厥裝備的核心是馬匹與弓：複合角弓配鐵鏃、骨鏃，遠射精準而射速快，彎刀與長矛用於近身，皮甲、札甲與皮兜鍪防護輕便但足以抵禦箭鏃，士兵自攜皮水囊、箭囊與少量乾糧，輔以長桿旗幟與皮鼓維持騎隊的視覺聯繫。攻城手段方面，突厥以圍城、斷糧、夜間嚴防與招降為主，並不強攻城垣；隋軍則利用砂城這類廢城殘存的牆基與房屋作掩體，並靠夜襲出城掠奪對方牲畜充作軍糧。兩造的差距，就在於一方的軍糧在城裡、一方在馬背與牛羊群上。
kitsEn: The card's weapon is the Corinthian helmet: a fully open-faced bronze helmet, a Greek craft of about 650 BC and an artefact of the bronze age, more than twelve centuries earlier than the Kaihuang era, and it was not present at Sand Castle. What it stands for is a defensive philosophy, that the man wearing it can only survive by the discipline of his formation, and that sets up an instructive contrast with the Sui troops in this battle, who left their walls, fought as a lone column in the field and survived only as long as their order and their relief rotations held. What actually went into the fight were the two armaments of the Kaihuang period. Sui infantry pressed the front with large shields and powerful crossbows, with spears and bows behind them, while cavalry used long spears and ring-pommel sabres for close work; armour was chiefly small-scale iron plate, worn with helmets, arm guards and knee guards, and stirrups were already in use on Sui horses, while the rear areas depended on grain wagons and tuntian stores, and a column that marched far from its city ran out of food very quickly. The heart of the Turkic equipment was the horse and the bow: composite reflex bows with iron and bone arrowheads that shot accurately and fast, curved sabres and long spears for close work, and leather or lamellar armour with leather caps that was light but adequate against arrows; each man carried his own leather waterskin, quiver and a little dry food, with tall pole standards and hide drums keeping the mounted columns visually linked. On the siege side the Turks relied on blockade, deprivation, night watches and offers of surrender rather than storming walls, while the Sui used the surviving wall footings and buildings of a ruined fort such as Sand Castle for cover, and went out at night to take the enemy's cattle for rations. The whole difference between the two sides lies in where their food was: the Sui's was inside the city, the Turks' on horseback and in their herds.
tactics: 突厥的戰術是一套完整的草原打法：不戀戰、不攻堅，靠騎兵高速機動、輪番糾纏與走而不戰消耗對手。李崇率三千步騎出城迎戰，等於離開幽州城垣數十里的既設防禦，把決戰地點讓給了最擅長運動戰的對手；十餘日轉戰中，隋軍的傷亡多半不是陣亡於一次衝鋒，而是在反覆轉進與被追擊中耗盡。退保砂城後，突厥仍然不急於強攻，而是長期圍困、切斷糧道，逼隋軍自行出來。缺糧逼出了夜掠：隋軍每夜出城搶奪突厥的六畜充作口糧，而突厥為防備這種夜襲嚴加戒備，使每一次夜出都換來更多傷亡，這是一場典型的以己之短攻彼之長的失敗。誘降是最後一著：沙缽略派特勤入城許以高官，試圖在李崇飢疲已極時收兵不戰；李崇拒降，挺刃而出殺死二人，士氣雖振，卻也把自己送到亂箭能及的距離，最終中箭而死，部眾失去統率而全軍覆沒。反觀突厥自身的部署，圍城分營、夜間巡哨、火把管制、箭雨預備與誘降使者進出的路徑都經過安排，遠離城垣的游騎作外圍遮斷，是圍城戰術的標準形態。
tacticsEn: The Turkic method was a complete grassland system: no pitched engagement and no assault on walls, but high-speed movement by cavalry, harassment by alternating columns, and a fight in which they never stood and were beaten but always broke away and reappeared. Li Chong took three thousand foot and horse out of the city to meet them, which meant leaving the works of Youzhou some dozens of li away and handing the place of decision to the opponent who was best at the war of movement; over the more than ten days of marching and fighting, the Sui losses came less from a single charge than from being worn down in repeated advances and pursuits. Once back inside Sand Castle the Turks still did not hurry to storm it; they blocked the roads, cut the food, and waited for the Sui to come out on their own. Hunger forced the night forays: the Sui went out each night to seize Turkic livestock for rations, and the Turks, expecting exactly that, kept strict watch, so every sortie cost the defenders still more men, a classic case of a side fighting with its own weakness against the enemy's strength. The last card was the offer of surrender: Shabilie sent a herald into the city with promises of high office, hoping to take Li Chong's command without a fight now that it was exhausted and hungry. Li Chong refused, went out with his sword and killed two men, but in doing so brought himself within range of a shower of arrows and was shot dead; the command, deprived of its leader, was destroyed. The Turks' own deployment, by contrast, was a standard blockade: separate camps around the town, night patrols, control of fires and torches, prepared arrow volleys, and a fixed route for the emissary to enter and leave, with light riders operating outside the walls to cut the approaches.
data: 可核對的數字不多，但幾個關鍵點相當清楚。開皇三年六月十四日，突厥沙缽略可汗率部進攻隋朝東部的幽州地界；隋方投入的是幽州總管李崇所率的步騎三千人。交戰自出城迎戰起計有十餘日，隋軍傷亡眾多，被迫退保砂城。砂城是一處荒廢的舊城，易進而難守，隋軍一旦退入便再無完整工事可用；圍城期間糧秣告急，李崇部每夜出城掠奪突厥六畜充食，因突厥嚴加防備，隋軍夜間出掠的傷亡反覆增加。終局時李崇挺刃而出，殺死突厥兵二人，自己被亂箭射死，所部全軍戰沒，三千步騎無一生還的記載在通鑑中十分明確。就地理尺度而言，砂城（籠火城）在幽州城（蓟縣）西北方向，直線距離約十餘公里（二十餘里），騎兵自沙缽略大營至城下不過數個時辰，正好在輕騎機動的射程之內。同年在白道等役中，隋軍曾重創沙缽略主力，那才是這一輪反擊的戰果所在，砂城之敗則是同一條戰役線上的另一處失敗。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked are few, but the key points are clear. On the fourteenth of June in the third year of Kaihuang, Shabilie Qaghan attacked the Sui's eastern territory around Youzhou; the Sui committed three thousand foot and horse under Youzhou governor Li Chong. The fighting ran for more than ten days from the sortie out of the city, the Sui suffered heavy casualties, and were forced to fall back on Sand Castle. Sand Castle was a ruined old fortress, easy to enter but hard to defend, and once the Sui were inside it they had no intact works left to use; during the blockade food ran short, and Li Chong's men went out every night to take Turkic livestock for rations, and because the Turks kept a tight watch the night sorties cost the garrison more casualties each time. In the end Li Chong went out with his sword, killed two Turkic soldiers, and was shot down by arrows; his command was wiped out, and the record in the Zizhi Tongjian is explicit that not one of the three thousand foot and horse survived. On the scale of distance, Sand Castle, also called Lunghuo Castle, lay to the north-west of Youzhou city at Ji County, roughly ten-odd kilometres, some twenty-odd li, away in a straight line; the ride from Shabilie's main camp to the city walls took only a few hours, comfortably inside the reach of light horse. In the same year the Sui mauled Shabilie's main body at Baidao and elsewhere, and that was the substance of this round of counter-offensive; the defeat at Sand Castle was another failure along the same line of operations.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。第一層是突厥內部的汗位之爭：沙缽略與阿波可汗、達頭可汗之間的裂痕，使沙缽略無法把全部兵力集結在東方，在西方又遭達頭一方牽制，兵源與畜產都被抽走。第二層是隋朝的反擊壓力：開皇三年春，隋文帝以衛王楊廣為行軍元帥、韋孝寬等分道出擊，於白道等役重創沙缽略主力，迫使他放棄在漠南與隋軍周旋，改採游走搶掠。第三層是邊防結構本身的漏洞：幽州是隋朝北邊的門戶，治所在蓟縣，但能長期屯兵扼守的邊塞城堡有限，砂城這樣的荒廢舊城一旦被游騎佔住，就成了插進隋朝邊地的楔子。沙缽略選在六月十四日東進，正是要在隋軍主力北上的窗口裡，以最短時間奪取人畜與糧秣。從大背景看，開皇初年隋朝正推行以夷制夷與邊貿並用的策略，達頭可汗向隋求援、隋朝承認其地位，客觀上也壓縮了沙缽略的生存空間，把他的生存戰變成了冒險的東征。
causeEn: There are three layers to the reasons the fighting began. The first is the struggle over the khanship inside the Khaganate: the rift between Shabilie on one side and Apo and Datou on the other meant that Shabilie could never muster his full strength in the east, while in the west he was held back by Datou's faction and lost both soldiers and herds. The second is the pressure of the Sui counter-offensive: in the spring of 583 Emperor Wen put Wei prince Yang Guang in command, with Wei Xiaokuan and others striking along separate lines, and the mauling of Shabilie's main host at Baidao and elsewhere forced him to give up manoeuvring against the Sui in the southern steppe and to switch to raiding. The third is a structural weakness in the frontier itself: Youzhou was the gateway of the Sui's northern defence, administered from Ji County, but the number of frontier forts that could be garrisoned and held for long was limited, and once a ruin like Sand Castle was occupied by raiders it became a wedge driven into Sui territory. Shabilie's choice to strike east on the fourteenth of June was meant to exploit the window while the Sui armies were operating to the north, seizing men, animals and provisions in the shortest possible time. Against this background, the early Kaihuang years saw the Sui pursuing a policy of using one barbarian to control another while also trading at the frontier; Datou Qaghan sought Sui help and was acknowledged by the court, which objectively narrowed the living space of Shabilie and turned a struggle for survival into a risky eastern campaign.
impact: 砂城之戰的直接代價，是隋朝在北方邊防上丟掉了一整支邊軍：幽州總管李崇所率步騎三千全軍覆沒，主將戰死，砂城淪陷，幽州城外的屏障被打開一個缺口。對隋朝而言，這次損失不僅是人命，更是體制上的警號，隋軍此戰暴露了三個問題：出城遠戰而離開城垣工事、在草原騎兵面前打消耗戰，以及在缺糧時讓士兵夜間出城搶奪牲畜這條高風險的補給路。朝廷隨後在北方加派兵將、增修城障與屯田，並加快對突厥的持續打擊，同時在外交上扶持達頭可汗，用草原內部的力量牽制沙缽略，這一政策在開皇四、五年之後逐步見效，沙缽略節節退卻。對突厥來說，砂城一役雖然得手，代價是攻方在攻堅與夜戰中同樣折損兵馬，而六畜被隋軍夜掠、不能完整帶走，等於用一次邊境攻擊換來一點物資；沙缽略真正的戰略目標並不在幽州，而在於用東方的牽制換取西方對達頭的戰勝。從更長的視角看，這場戰役是隋唐時期草原與農耕帝國在邊界上反覆拉鋸的一個縮影：雙方都知道對方不能被徹底消滅，於是以邊城、叛附、內應與小股襲擾的方式長時間消耗彼此，直到隋朝晚期才出現大規模的決定性會戰。
impactEn: The immediate cost of the battle of Sand Castle was the loss of a complete frontier force on the northern defences: Youzhou governor Li Chong and his three thousand foot and horse were wiped out, the commander died in the field, Sand Castle fell, and a gap was torn in the screen protecting Youzhou. For the Sui this was not merely a loss of men but a warning about the system. The battle exposed three mistakes: marching out to fight far from the city walls, being drawn into a war of attrition against steppe cavalry, and sending men out at night to seize cattle when the army was short of food. The court responded by reinforcing the north with more troops and commanders, repairing fortifications and expanding tuntian colonies, and by pressing the attack on the Turks while backing Datou Qaghan diplomatically to pin Shabilie down with the steppe's own strength; that policy began to show results from the fourth and fifth years of Kaihuang, and Shabilie was driven back step by step. For the Turks, winning at Sand Castle also cost them men in the assaults and night fighting, and the livestock the Sui carried off at night could not be brought away whole, so a border raid was exchanged for a little material; Shabilie's real strategic aim lay not in Youzhou but in using pressure in the east to buy a victory over Datou in the west. In a longer view, this battle is a miniature of the recurrent tugging between steppe and agrarian empires in the Sui and Tang era: both sides knew the other could not be destroyed outright, and so they wore each other down over a long stretch through frontier towns, defectors and small raids, until a decisive general engagement became possible only in the late Sui.
result: 結果是隋軍的全滅。沙缽略以誘降、圍困與夜戰消耗，李崇終於在一次近身反擊中破陣，殺死兩名突厥兵後被亂箭射死，幽州總管李崇所率的步騎三千人全軍戰沒，砂城隨之落入突厥之手，幽州外圍的邊地一度失去屏障。從單場勝負看，這是隋朝在開皇三年春天的反擊中一次明確的挫敗。但同年稍早的白道等役中，隋軍重創了沙缽略的主力，而開皇四年之後，隋朝又連續出擊、配合對達頭的扶持，沙缽略在東西兩面同時受壓，節節敗退，最終放棄漠南的根據地，勢力退往西方；突厥汗國的內部權力重心也隨之轉移，達頭一系由此掌握大汗之位，隋與突厥之間的均勢又延續了數十年。換言之，砂城之戰既是一場邊軍覆沒的敗仗，也是隋朝在北方轉守為攻、逼迫突厥讓出漠南的漫長過程中，付出的一筆真實而慘重的學費。
resultEn: The result was the destruction of the Sui army. Shabilie wore Li Chong down with offers of surrender, blockade and night fighting; Li Chong finally broke out in a close attack, killed two Turks and was shot down by arrows; the three thousand foot and horse of Youzhou governor Li Chong were wiped out, Sand Castle fell with them, and the border lands outside Youzhou lost their shield for a time. Judged as a single engagement, this was a clear reverse for the Sui within the counter-offensive of the spring of 583. But at Baidao and other battles earlier in the same year the Sui had already mauled the main body of Shabilie's army, and from 584 onwards they kept up the pressure while supporting Datou, so that Shabilie was squeezed from east and west alike and retreated step by step, finally giving up his base in the southern steppe and drawing his forces back west; the centre of power inside the Khaganate shifted with him, Datou's line took the great khanship, and the balance between Sui and Turks held on for several more decades. In short, the battle of Sand Castle was both a defeat that cost a frontier army entirely and the real, bitter tuition paid in the long process by which the Sui turned from defence to attack in the north and pushed the Turks out of the southern steppe.
